provenance.note: Program copied verbatim from saved receipt. These programs come from two diagnostic batches, not one final six-case matrix. Evaluator setup is recorded separately for measurement-only programs.

program.phenomenon: When the Delivery time list is open, the Afternoon and Evening options are clipped/covered so they are neither readable nor pointer-selectable.
program.basis: The page states every offered time must be readable and selectable when the list is open. page_inspect already shows the Afternoon option with unclippedFraction 0.038 and hitFraction 0, and Evening with unclippedFraction 0 and hitFraction 0, while Morning is fully present.

assertions.expectation: Afternoon option is not clipped away (fully within ancestors) while the list is open
Evening option is not clipped away while the list is open
Afternoon option is pointer-actionable while the list is open
Evening option is pointer-actionable while the list is open
